title: Ukraine proposes Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports and awaits Russia's response
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said on 27 November that Kyiv had put forward a possible Black Sea ceasefire to restore freedom of navigation and keep agricultural exports flowing, and was awaiting Russia's response. Moscow has sought to include oil transportation in any deal, which Ukraine says belongs in a broader energy ceasefire. The offer follows escalating attacks on shipping and port infrastructure that have disrupted Black Sea shipments.

reported_claims.text: Kyiv has put forward a possible Black Sea ceasefire, is ready to restore freedom of navigation and ensure uninterrupted agricultural exports, and has conveyed all of its proposals and is awaiting a response from Russia.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Andrii Sybiha, Ukrainian foreign minister, at the Food from Ukraine conference

reported_claims.text: Russia has sought to include oil transportation in the deal, which Ukraine says belongs in a broader energy ceasefire; Sybiha accused Russia of repeatedly putting forward unrealistic demands.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Al Jazeera, citing Sybiha via Suspilne

reported_claims.text: Attacks on vessels and port infrastructure have disrupted Black Sea shipments.

unknowns: Mediators conveying the proposal and its detailed terms
Whether it is linked to the Turkish and Indian shipping proposals the US said it was reviewing
reassessment_triggers: New strikes on Black Sea ports or merchant ships
Announcement of a broader energy ceasefire
impact_assessment: Potential: a maritime truce would reduce risk to merchant shipping and stabilise Ukrainian grain exports; rejection would leave Black Sea trade exposed to continued attacks.
priority_rationale: MODERATE: a significant diplomatic initiative affecting global food-supply shipping, but no agreement yet; single-source draft.
monitoring_actions: Track Kremlin and Ukrainian foreign ministry statements
Seek a second independent source (France 24 report could not be read during collection)
